cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accounts keeps missing tea. Give me the kitchen keys. I taught you to solve a problem at its source.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's one. But the cleaners lock the kettle in their cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've found the next weak link. Send me their checklist; I'll approve what they lock away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their contractor only takes instructions from the building manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally following the chain. Bring me his instructions for approval too. You can't expect your teacher to guarantee tea while leaving half the process to strangers.

reason: Make the teacher claim operate through actual corrections of B response and concrete invitations or demands, preserving exact Drive and all reply causes.
